Author: Macki
Name: Glance
Description: Public beta. Meet your character's gaze during idle close-ups. Choose Wink, Playful, Friendly, Dramatic, Custom, or gaze-only mode; tune expression frequency and duration in /glance. Camera tracking and expression timing are experimental. Icon created with AI assistance.
Punchline: A little eye contact. A little personality.
Changelog: Personality presets, custom expression pools, adjustable frequency and durations, and a gaze-only Off option. Random selections avoid consecutive repeats; zoom-out cancels expressions and resets to neutral.
